components.css: .ds-directional-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#aaa9a4;font:500 12px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:color 240ms ease,letter-spacing 280ms ease,text-shadow 240ms ease,transform 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-directional-cta span{display:grid;width:26px;height:26px;place-items:center;border:1px solid #3a3a37;border-radius:50%;color:#c8f55f;font-weight:700;transition:border-color 240ms ease,background-color 240ms ease,color 240ms ease,box-shadow 240ms ease,transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-directional-cta:hover,.ds-directional-cta:focus-visible{color:#fff;letter-spacing:.016em;text-shadow:.35px 0 currentColor,-.35px 0 currentColor;transform:translateY(-1px);outline:none}.ds-directional-cta:hover span,.ds-directional-cta:focus-visible span{border-color:#c8f55f;background:#c8f55f;color:#080808;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgb(200 245 95 / 18%);transform:translate(3px,-3px) rotate(3deg)}

narrative.overview: Pontail presents shipped products as a premium gallery of evidence. A near-black canvas, large neo-grotesque typography, disciplined hairline grids, and carefully staged product imagery let the work command attention without agency-style theatrics. The system is restrained at rest and expressive in response. Its premium quality comes from exact spacing, scale, and kinetic detail: arrows lift with intent, imagery gains clarity and motion, and surfaces change tone without introducing decorative noise. Enhancement should sharpen this behavior while preserving the incumbent identity.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, warm-white, and calibrated gray hierarchy.
Oversized, tightly tracked headlines with concise supporting copy.
Square editorial grids and hairline structural borders.
Product imagery as the dominant proof layer.
Rare signal-lime accents reserved for meaningful interaction.
Smooth, coordinated motion that respects reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Rare Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Lime belongs to small, meaningful interaction cues; never spread it across large surfaces or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Warm Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Prefer the established warm whites and green-gray neutrals over cold pure grays; pure white is an interaction peak, not the default.

rules.name: The Scale Before Ornament Rule
rules.body: Create hierarchy with size, weight, tracking, and whitespace before introducing color or decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat until state or hierarchy requires depth; shadows must communicate interaction or modal layering.

dos: Do preserve the near-black canvas, warm neutral hierarchy, and square proof grid.
Do let product imagery and shipped-work copy provide the visual interest.
Do coordinate hover motion across text, arrow, image, and surface as one response.
Do use Signal Lime rarely and at compact scale for meaningful interaction.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior whenever animation is enhanced.
Do improve premium perception through spacing, timing, easing, and alignment before adding decoration.
donts: Don't replace the incumbent system with glossy startup gradients, glassmorphism, playful illustration, or decorative clutter.
Don't round the primary product grid or turn every surface into a floating card.
Don't use lime as a large background, ambient wash, or repeated decorative accent.
Don't add motion that is constant, disconnected from user intent, or necessary for comprehension.
Don't fabricate awards, testimonials, client logos, benchmarks, or product proof.
